old_h_failure_boundaries: h remains strict expected-gradient SHA failure despite finite nonzero gradients and no OOM.
Its failure payload did not preserve actual source SHA, bitwise forward values or after-backward frozen fingerprint. New protocols cannot backfill those facts onto h.
g/h scalar-max difference is not an elementwise gradient error; eight fewer nonzero coordinates is not a support-location comparison.
A1/A2 mismatch diagnoses scaled-single repeatability first. Exact A1/A2 plus different B narrows graph-history/execution effects without identifying a specific native kernel.
remaining_acceptance_limits: Fresh queue admission and remote immutable snapshot verification remain root responsibilities; this file does not launch jobs.
CPU source plumbing tests cannot establish real H3 zero-adapter numerical exactness or NPU gradients.
A successful tiny latent-only probe cannot close full22-frame DiT+VAE+LoRA joint-memory or restoration-quality gates.
Nonzero unmerged adapter save/reload parity, RGB-loss backward, and convergence/quality are later separate gates; BF16 merged inference parity must not be assumed.
VAE A1/A2 observation complete is separate from exact-repeatability acceptance. Paired-history memory is not a single-backward training memory measurement.
